review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped for the homotopy bridge declarations. The file builds an isomorphism of fundamental-groupoid functors from either `SimplicialObject.Homotopy` or `SSet.Homotopy`. `SSet.Homotopy.toSimplicialObjectHomotopy` is defined in `SimplicialSet/Homotopy.lean`, and this file reuses it. The edge, diagonal and `CompStruct` declarations are new constructions specific to the fundamental groupoid, and I found no existing Mathlib versions of them. `congrMapFundamentalGroupoid'` and `congrMapFundamentalGroupoid` accept different homotopy notions, so they are not competing copies of one concept. I found no justified duplication finding. I did not search the rest of Mathlib exhaustively for functor-isomorphism-from-homotopy constructions.
